purpose: Apply the existing capacity-definition rule consistently; update allocation-dependent results without changing national demand, regional planning inputs or scenario parameters.

input_decisions.confirmed_wrong_quantity: Correct an identified generation attribute; retain the raw record and raw-attribute sensitivity.
input_decisions.unclear_capacity_basis: Retain the announced scale as a project-scale location proxy with its uncertainty; missing primary confirmation is not an exclusion criterion.
input_decisions.future_delivery: Represent buildout, timing and effective response through stated scenarios; do not require future realization to define a scenario.
input_decisions.unsupported_inference: Narrow the interpretation rather than present a proxy as a measured load or a scenario outcome as an observed effect.
input_decisions.joule_source_row_1152: Exclude the generation attribute: 455 MW and 12000 MW are different dated supply stages, not DC-load bounds. Retain the raw record and count alternatives.
input_decisions.gw_ranch_source_row_1059: Exclude the 1000 MW generation-delivery stage; retain project count and raw attributes.
input_decisions.ridgeline_source_row_1664: Exclude the turbine-capacity attribute; 5650 MMBtu/hr is about 1656 MW thermal, not DC electrical load.
input_decisions.new_era_source_row_641: Retain the separately advertised 7+ GW planned campus scale as a conditional location proxy; do not derive load from gas-plus-nuclear supply totals.

national_energy.definition: LBNL total facility electricity use including infrastructure overhead and excluding cryptocurrency mining.
national_energy.post_2030: Author-defined hold, quarter-rate and half-rate continuations; not LBNL forecasts after 2030.

project_weight.definition: A conditional location proxy from reported project scale, capacity endpoints, record counts or the labeled size-rank alternative.

candidate_increment.definition: Allocated national energy mapped to a peak-equivalent load, minus the same scenario's 2025 level.
candidate_increment.supply_assumption: The candidate increment is supplied by the regional grid.
candidate_increment.onsite_generation: Neither added as a regional resource nor subtracted from the candidate solely from campus co-location.
candidate_increment.regional_weights: Fixed through the horizon; the 2025 regional allocation is a scenario anchor, not observed 2025 consumption.

official_demand.definition: The retained July 2025 planning-vintage demand, including its embedded data-center and other load categories.

county_display.2025: Archived effective-area within-region shape, normalized to scenario regional totals; CA/NV area split retained.
county_display.2035: 2025 allocated county load plus growth distributed by reviewed project-scale weights.
county_display.rule_change: Both revised capacity attributes and a revised county downscaling rule affect county concentration.
county_display.interpretation: Descriptive allocation, not observed county demand or verified electrical service.

scope_and_geography.default_inventory: Broader siting evidence than the non-mining national-energy category; it is not claimed to be a scope-matched electricity inventory.
scope_and_geography.scope_alternatives: Five existing families change seven-region shares at fixed national energy and reviewed footprint capture.
scope_and_geography.scope_alternatives_do_not: Recompute the national non-mining denominator, identify a mining MW fraction or establish population-wide connection accuracy.
scope_and_geography.legacy_weight_row: Uses raw-attribute regional shares at current fixed capture, not a complete old-default calculation.
scope_and_geography.complete_old_default: Updates both old capture and old shares in the separately retained comparison.
scope_and_geography.california: WECC-California planning ledger with its documented component-polygon siting proxy, not CAISO alone.
scope_and_geography.assignment_sensitivity: Separate regional extrema within archived candidate service regions; not a simultaneous joint assignment or an empirical probability.

accounting.native_conventions: Retain regional capacity accreditation, peak aggregation and seasonal reference requirements; do not sum balances across regions.
accounting.replacement: Remove identified incremental official growth and associated response, then insert candidate growth and its associated response with resources fixed.
accounting.other_regions: PJM is a cross-vintage classified-subset diagnostic; remaining candidate cases are additional-load stresses, not identified full replacements.
accounting.paired_pressure: Matched background balance minus candidate balance.
accounting.added_requirement: Candidate positive planning gap minus background positive planning gap.
accounting.counterfactual_scope: Controlled comparisons with fixed resources, not equilibrium investment or observed causal effects.

response_and_timing.current_only: Cap ordinary response at its first forecast-year value, retain declines and exclude ERCOT provisional large-load curtailment.
response_and_timing.published: Retain the full annual reported response, conditional on its assumed effectiveness.
response_and_timing.association: Fractions 0, 0.5 and 1 allocate response to removed and inserted growth; they are not delivery probabilities.
response_and_timing.transfer: The same response fraction may expand with candidate load.
response_and_timing.fixed_budget_alternative: The existing targeted 2035 check caps candidate-associated response at the source budget; it is not an all-year budget test.
response_and_timing.realization: ERCOT effective provisional curtailment is a separate scenario dimension covering large loads beyond data centers.
response_and_timing.all_year_limits: Apply a common scale to the complete candidate increment and associated response, with the matched background fixed.
response_and_timing.counts: 648 amplitude-shape combinations are descriptive scenarios, not independent observations; endpoint rescaling cancels amplitude.

pv_storage.annual_energy: Chronological 2016-2025 simulation at five equally weighted sites per region.
pv_storage.peak_relief: Summer 2025 top-100 load hours; nested top-50 and top-200 sensitivities.
pv_storage.physical_interval: EIA demand ending at t matches POWER irradiance starting at t minus one hour.
pv_storage.dispatch: Constant load, PV-only charging, independent site storage, fixed power/energy limits, losses and chronological state of charge.

evidence_and_claims.historical: The retained source forecast does not outperform persistence; the auxiliary calibrated comparator is separate from main resource inputs.
evidence_and_claims.regional_studies: Compare studies on their native ledgers; do not infer an error score by exchanging ICAP, UCAP or accreditation conventions.
evidence_and_claims.nuclear: Report size and restart/retention plans; omit an added-credit claim without a matched baseline and capacity basis.
retained: simulated energy and sampled peak-hour services
not_claimed: aggregate national shortfall from unlike native balances

locations.main: Methods: Study design and scope; Data sources and national load paths; Paired data-center contribution and pathway replacement.
locations.supplement: Notes 1, 3-5, 10, 19-26 and the scope/county/attribute table notes.
